source_publisher: Greater London Authority / London City Hall
source_window_contract: One officially numbered Housing Zone detail record per bounded window in published numeric order; resource_index is zero-based and published_zone_number=resource_index+1; never replay a consumed resource_index.
cross_source_real_project_dedupe_policy: Do not add a Housing Zone record when its normalized official project/area title exactly collides with an already mirrored real project/area title from another authoritative source family. Such a new source window is checkpointed as SKIPPED_EXISTING_REAL_SITE with an empty shard and duplicate_count_new=0.
geometry_policy: No inferred geometry; geometry null for City Hall page records.
completion_month_policy: null unless official source explicitly provides YYYY-MM completion
